title: Resolve cramping and auto-reopening bugs in GitDiffSidebar
summary: Expanded GitDiffSidebar default width to 480px, added an interactive left-edge drag resize handle (360px-840px, persisted to localStorage), and restructured the header with flex-wrap, compact badges (text-[10px], px-1.5 py-0.5), and cleanly truncated branch badge with tooltip. Fixed the auto-reopening bug by tracking initial load state (hasInitialLoadedRef) and explicit user-collapsed files (userCollapsedFilesRef) so background syncs triggered by live agent tool events never forcibly reopen files the user collapsed. Added anti-race disposal pattern for async Tauri event listeners.
